'''Polain''' was an independent [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] who worked regularly in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]], and learned that the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] was equipping [[S9-series heavy power droid|S9 power droids]] with radiation shielding to harass [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Radiation zone assault trooper|radtroopers]] during combat.
